name: MTTM + Pure Obsessions & Red Nights
description: French darkwave/synthpop/industrial outfit Pure Obsessions & Red Nights hit Berlin as part of their 2026 European tour celebrating 'The Night Trilogy', mixing their own darkwave anthems with re-imagined 80s classics. MTTM—a Berlin-based darkwave/post-punk duo—opens with synth-driven hooks, restless guitars, and late-night existentialism. Urban Spree's graffiti walls and industrial courtyard make it perfect for this: small venue, sweat, and zero distance between band and crowd. A true darkwave concert in Berlin in 2026.
